snippet.title: DEMON'S REIGN Trailer
snippet.description:
DEMON'S REIGN is a new dark fantasy RPG Maker game inspired by earlier souslikes. It is heavily focused on exploration and character building, and set in a long forgotten past in the world of Dungeon Mori.

Wishlist it on Steam and play the Demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4605940/DEMONS_REIGN
